title: fix(plugin-auth): a SCIM bearer write carrying a Cookie and no Origin is no longer refused 403 MISSING_OR_NULL_ORIGIN
body:
Fixes #33237

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`AuthManager.handleRequest` 在把请求交给 better-auth 之前,对带 `Authorization: Bearer` 的 `/scim/v2/*` 请求去掉 `Cookie` 头;其余路由一律不动。
- 为什么改:better-auth 的来源检查只要请求带任何 Cookie 就要求 `Origin`,于是带 Cookie 罐(如 Cloudflare `__cf_bm`、粘性会话 Cookie)的身份提供方(Okta 已实测)做 SCIM 开通与停用全部被拒 403,离职员工的访问无法由目录撤销。SCIM 只认 bearer,Cookie 在该路径上不带任何权限。
- 风险与回滚:风险面只有「`/scim/v2/*` 且带 bearer」这一种请求;无 bearer 的 SCIM 请求与所有浏览器路由仍走原来的来源检查。回滚即 revert 本 PR 的那一个 `if` 块。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-request-routing.ts`(新增的 `if` 块,判定条件三项是风险点);`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-bearer-cookie-origin.test.ts`(四个用例与 `boot()` 里把来源检查打开的那几行)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run src/scim-bearer-cookie-origin.test.ts`,预期 4 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-request-routing.ts`, `handleRequest`: right after the vendor client-address rewrite, a request whose better-auth endpoint path is under `/scim/v2` (`isScimProtocolPath`, the predicate the SCIM request scope already keys on) AND that carries `Authorization: Bearer` followed by a credential AND that carries a `Cookie` is rebuilt without the `Cookie` header before better-auth sees it. This is the route that relaxes no check: no global or per-path origin-check exemption is added, and `skipOriginCheck` / `disableCSRFCheck` are not touched.

Why it is safe, measured on better-auth 1.7.12 and `@better-auth/scim` 1.7.12 as installed:

- `validateOrigin` (`dist/api/middlewares/origin-check.mjs`) reads `useCookies = headers.has("cookie")` off the request `handleRequest` hands it; with a cookie and no Origin or Referer it throws `MISSING_OR_NULL_ORIGIN`. That is the whole defect.
- Every `/scim/v2/*` mutation endpoint is `use: [authMiddleware]`, and that middleware (`createSCIMConnectionMiddleware`) authenticates from `Authorization: Bearer` alone: no bearer is `401 SCIM bearer token is required`. The platform's `verifyBearerToken` (`auth-manager-plugin-list.ts`) reads only `input.token`.
- SCIM writes are attributed to the verified connection (`authSystemWriteContext` returns `actor: svc:scim:CONNECTION_ID` first and never consults the session resolver when a SCIM connection is in scope), so stripping the cookie changes no attribution either.
- A SCIM request with NO bearer keeps its cookie and still meets the origin check (pinned below).

The landing is the expected file; no producer elsewhere was needed. `auth-manager.ts`, `auth-plugin.ts` and the better-auth pin are untouched.

`.changeset/33237-scim-bearer-cookie-origin.md`: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch.

## Tests

New file `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/scim-bearer-cookie-origin.test.ts` (real `AuthManager`, real `ObjectQL` on better-sqlite3, SCIM on, a minted connection credential: the `scim-transaction-scope.test.ts` harness shape). Four cases:

1. SCIM bearer `POST /Users` with `Cookie: __cf_bm=...; better-auth.session_token=` and no Origin: 201 and the `sys_user` row exists.
2. SCIM bearer `PATCH /Users/{id}` `active:false` with the same Cookie and no Origin: 200, resource `active: false`.
3. SCIM `POST /Users` with the Cookie and NO bearer: still 403, `code` `MISSING_OR_NULL_ORIGIN`, no `sys_user` row written.
4. CONTROL: a real session cookie (from sign-up) on `POST /sign-out` with no Origin: still 403, `code` `MISSING_OR_NULL_ORIGIN`.

How production semantics are ensured: two things would mask the bug under vitest, and the harness turns off both. `handleRequest` synthesizes a same-origin Origin outside production: every case runs with `vi.stubEnv('NODE_ENV', 'production')` and asserts it reads back. And better-auth reads NODE_ENV once at module load (`@better-auth/core/env`), so under vitest it defaults `skipOriginCheck` to `true` (`create-context.mjs`: `disableOriginCheck` unset means `isTest()`): `boot()` sets the production value `false` on the live `$context` and asserts `skipCSRFCheck` is `false`. Before that line was added, cases 3 and 4 were red on the unfixed tree (the control POST answered 200), which is how the masking was found.

Red on the unfixed tree (commit e9076fa2a2, test only): cases 1 and 2 fail with `{"message":"Missing or null Origin","code":"MISSING_OR_NULL_ORIGIN"}: expected 403 to be 201` (and `to be 200`); cases 3 and 4 pass.

Ablation (one-time, on the fix commit c8abb27264, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): the anchor `headers.delete('cookie');` replaced by a comment, anchor 1 to 0, blob 944e5a37b0bd to efaf0d39e2b3; cases 1 and 2 red again with 403, cases 3 and 4 green; restored, blob after restore 944e5a37b0bd equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `./auth-manager.js` relatively, so the subject resolves to `src/`, no `dist/` step.

## Acceptance notes

- Behaviour change beyond the card's three cases, stated so it is not a surprise: a `/scim/v2/*` bearer request that carries a Cookie AND an untrusted Origin used to be refused 403 `INVALID_ORIGIN`; it now reaches the SCIM bearer check like any bearer client. Same reasoning: the origin check guards cookie authority, and there is none on this path.
- The vendor's origin check is skipped wholesale under a test NODE_ENV, so any plugin-auth test that means to observe it must put `skipOriginCheck = false` on the context as `boot()` here does. Observation only; no card.
- The cloud hosted proxy strip (cloud#4498) can retire once a release carrying this reaches cloud's pin; that is cloud's and the maintainer's call on cloud#4491.
